hints.title: Axis-Aligned Edge Classification
hints.text: Group points sharing the same horizontal or vertical coordinate to identify candidate bases parallel to coordinate axes.

hints.title: Base Length Maximization
hints.text: For any fixed coordinate line with multiple points, choose the extreme endpoints to maximize the base length.

hints.title: Extreme Height Selection
hints.text: The third vertex providing maximum perpendicular height is either at the global minimum or global maximum opposite coordinate.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def maxTriangleArea(self, points: List[List[int]]) -> float:
        x_pts = defaultdict(list)
        y_pts = defaultdict(list)
        all_x = []
        all_y = []
        
        for x, y in points:
            x_pts[x].append(y)
            y_pts[y].append(x)
            all_x.append(x)
            all_y.append(y)
            
        min_x, max_x = min(all_x), max(all_x)
        min_y, max_y = min(all_y), max(all_y)
        
        max_area = 0.0
        
        # Vertical base: same x, varying y
        for x, ys in x_pts.items():
            if len(ys) >= 2:
                base = max(ys) - min(ys)
                height = max(abs(x - min_x), abs(x - max_x))
                area = 0.5 * base * height
                if area > max_area:
                    max_area = area
                    
        # Horizontal base: same y, varying x
        for y, xs in y_pts.items():
            if len(xs) >= 2:
                base = max(xs) - min(xs)
                height = max(abs(y - min_y), abs(y - max_y))
                area = 0.5 * base * height
                if area > max_area:
                    max_area = area
                    
        return max_area
```

complexity.notes: Grouping points along axes and inspecting global coordinate bounds.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all triplets of vertices requires O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash maps index points by coordinate line in linear memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that maximum height is attained at global axis extremes.
